Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid: Integer,balance: Real,status: LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanAccount: LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(la|la.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid),
		isNew: LoanAccount = loanAccount.oclIsNew()
	precondition:
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(loanAccount) = bool
	postcondition:
		let newLoanAccount: LoanAccount in
		newLoanAccount.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(newLoanAccount)
}
